name: The Poet's Visual Novel
source:
While visiting Helsinki to attend a film festival, a naive but ambitious poet and her artist friend run into a game developer and decide to make a visual novel together. To pass time between screenings, they idle at coffee shops, parks, and malls, trying to come up with ideas for the game. As days blur into each other, events start to reoccur.

Inspired by the films of Hong Sangsoo, The Poet's Visual Novel is a short VN about the highs and lows of the artist's life, unremarkable details, and the power of coincidences.

[From [url=https://purkka.itch.io/the-poets-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在前往赫尔辛基参加电影节时，一位天真但雄心勃勃的诗人和她的艺术家朋友遇到了一位游戏开发人员，并决定一起制作一部视觉小说。为了打发放映间隙的时间，他们在咖啡馆、公园和购物中心闲逛，试图为游戏想出一些创意。随着日子一天天过去，事件开始重新发生。

受到洪尚秀电影的启发，诗人的视觉小说是一部简短的VN，讲述了艺术家生活的高潮和低谷、不起眼的细节以及巧合的力量。

[来自[url=https://purkka.itch.io/the-poets-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
